_meta.doc: League entrances keyed by the battle event. The kicker names the room, the epithet sets the scene, and lines are spoken by the trainer assigned to the match. Keep the first line intact in compact presentations. Lines stay independent of a trainer's build and the player's undiscovered evidence. The Mystery Figure has its own threshold entrance.
_meta.editing: Add or rewrite entries freely — strings render verbatim (HTML-escaped). Keep lines ≤ ~110 chars.

Victory Road.epithet: Snow has settled around eight worn insignias on the gate.
lines: The gate is behind you. From here, your partner sets the pace.
If you need to stop, say so. The mountain makes its own rules. This match is ours.

E1.epithet: The attendant hangs a fresh scorecard. Below it, the paper is yellow.
lines: You earned the right to open this door. Now show me and my team how you got here.
I keep a longer memory than that scorecard. Give me a reason to use it.

E2.epithet: The corridor goes quiet as the padded door closes.
lines: Take a breath. I won't start with your hand still on the door.
Whenever you're ready. My team has been watching the light above the gate.

E3.epithet: The previous bouts echo through a vent beneath the floor.
lines: You've shown the other two your first answer. I want to see what you do when it fails.
Watch your opponent, then check your partner. The order matters.

E4.epithet: The floor lights end at an unopened gate.
lines: Beyond that gate is the Champion. My job is to make opening it feel earned.
Give your partner a moment. They've carried every room into this one with you.

Champion.epithet: The lights settle on both sides of the ring. The seat above it is empty.
lines: The Four told me how you fought. I wanted to see how your partner walks in beside you.
The seat can wait. For as long as we're out here, all I want is a good battle.
